# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 28 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices & Market Pulse

- **Private home prices rose 0.5% in Q2 2026, slowest first-half growth since 2020** - URA's Q2 2026 data shows the overall private residential price index up 0.5% QoQ, easing from 0.9% in Q1, with non-landed prices dipping even as resale transactions drove a 13.6% rise in total sales volume. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-condo-prices-just-had-their-slowest-first-half-since-2020/)

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units at launch weekend** - The 380-unit development sold 212 units at an average of S$3,140 psf, marking the first private residential launch within the upcoming Bukit Timah Turf City precinct. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-sells-212-units-averaging-3140-psf-at-launch/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026** - Transaction volumes picked up in the secondary market while prices held largely flat, reflecting a period of stabilisation. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale prices fell 0.3% in Q2 2026 — second consecutive quarterly decline** - HDB's Resale Price Index slipped 0.3% QoQ even as transaction activity edged higher, continuing a trend of gradual market stabilisation. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

- **Million-dollar HDB flat sales hit a record 491 units in Q2 2026** - Despite the overall index declining for a second straight quarter, the number of million-dollar flat transactions reached a new record high in the same period. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fall-for-a-second-straight-quarter-but-million-dollar-flat-sales-just-hit-a-record-high/)

## Mortgage Rates

- **SORA has bottomed near 1.14% after peaking at 4% in 2023–2024** - The sharp drop in SORA has opened a refinancing window for both HDB and condo owners, though the article notes the cheapest home loan rate is not always the most suitable one. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-best-mortgage-rates-are-back-but-cheapest-home-loan-isnt-always-the-best-one/)
